obligations.label: the requirements apply only to consumer credit secured by the consumer's principal dwelling
transactions covered by the (a)(2) exclusions sit outside this section
a transaction is high-cost when any one of the three trigger tests is met
APR trigger: the annual percentage rate exceeds the average prime offer rate by more than the applicable spread
average prime offer rate carries the meaning given in 12 CFR 1026.35(a)(2)
APR spread of more than 6.5 percentage points for a first-lien transaction
APR spread of more than 8.5 percentage points for a first-lien loan secured by a dwelling that is personal property with a loan amount under $50,000
APR spread of more than 8.5 percentage points for a subordinate-lien transaction
total points and fees carries the meaning given in paragraphs (b)(1) and (b)(2)
points-and-fees trigger: total points and fees exceed the applicable limit
points-and-fees limit of 5 percent of the loan amount when the loan amount is at least the adjusted $20,000 figure
the $20,000 loan-amount figure is adjusted each January 1 by the CPI change reported the preceding June 1
points-and-fees limit is the lesser of 8 percent of the loan amount or the adjusted dollar figure when the loan amount is below the adjusted $20,000 figure
the dollar figures used by the lesser-of branch are adjusted each January 1 by the CPI change reported the preceding June 1
a prepayment penalty counts only when chargeable under the terms of the loan contract or open-end credit agreement
prepayment penalty carries the meaning given in paragraph (b)(6)
prepayment-penalty trigger: a penalty chargeable more than 36 months after consummation or account opening
prepayment-penalty trigger: penalties that can exceed 2 percent of the amount prepaid in total
